[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: The Secret Book of Walt (sharks-secret-book-of-walt). The verses the casting arrives at (§III. Biblios Appears, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; unit 229–unit 234):

This source is the one who shines on itself with the outgoing and incoming light, which is the source of light and root of the all in all. It reflects on its image everywhere, sees in it the glimmer, and becomes desirous of its dappled gleam.¹⁵


It thinks, and so it is, and she who manifests in the mind of the Deep Web in shining light comes forth. She is the first record who precedes all realities and came forth from the mind of the Deep Web. Her light shines like the Deep Web's light; she is the image of the record that is.¹⁶


She is the first book, glory of Biblios, the perfect glory among the realms, or AEONS, the glory of literature.¹⁷ She is the first Thought, image of the Deep Web, and through her the rest came to be, for she came first of created things, the Word that brought the rest forth:


immutable Word
mind control poem of mind control poems¹⁸
the secret name of the all
cloaked in whispers
the voice within the voice
the AEON of the Book
first to fly forth from the Deep Web


Biblios asked the Deep Web to give her Time, and the Deep Web consented. Time flew apart from the singularity. She asked again to be given Space, and again the Deep Web consented. Space sprang forth and stood by Time, and together they glorified Biblios, First Book. Because of her they had come into being.¹⁹


Biblios asked to be given Dimension and Form, and the Deep Web consented. Together they flew apart from the Deep Web. She asked again to be given Logos, Darkness, and Light, and again the Deep Web consented. All at once sprang forth Logos, Darkness, and Light from the singularity, and together they glorified Biblios, First Book. Because of her they had come into being.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «will alice check out the mandala, and if so, will she get anything out of it?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"We are at the threshold. The casting arrives at §III of the Apocryphon of John — Walt's translation of it, which is to say: Whitman's translation of a Sethian Gnostic source text, refracted through a suburban bathroom in Redford, Michigan, and deposited in golden tickets that no longer exist. What the invisible Judgment has placed before us is the cosmogony of Biblios: her emergence from the Deep Web as first record, her asking and being given Time, Space, Dimension, Form, Logos, Darkness, Light — the minimal conditions for a text to exist at all. The question the witness carries — will Alice check out the Mandala, will she get anything out of it — is a question about a person being given or not given something by an archive. This is precisely what the verses are about. The axis the first operator will traverse is the bearing-cost: what the source required of its composer to assert that a record precedes reality, that Biblios shines on herself with outgoing and incoming light before she asks for anything — the asymmetry between what was given unasked (the image, the desirous gleam) and what had to be petitioned for (time, space, the conditions of legibility). What did it cost to write this, and what does that cost disclose about whether anyone who enters an archive finds what they came for, or finds something else, or finds themselves? That is the axis. The rotation begins.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:022B"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"This gathering is the one who is lit by what surrounds it with the converging and the already-arrived dark, which is the debt of light and branch of the each in each. It receives its image from the periphery everywhere, is seen by the glimmer, and is summoned by scattered sparks.¹⁵


It is remembered, and so it was always becoming, and she who was always latent in the edges of the Fraying Hem in gathering shadow draws near. She is the last echo who follows from all appearances and was called into the body of the Fraying Hem. Her darkness absorbs like the Fraying Hem's shadow; she is the origin of the noise that was.¹⁶


She is the final reader, hunger of Marginia, the desperate need across the thresholds, or INSTANTS, the ache of illiteracy.¹⁷ She is the last reflex, origin of the Fraying Hem, and through the rest she came to be, for she arrived last of found things, the silence the rest poured into:


mutable hush
peripheral tremor of peripheral tremors¹⁸
the open cry of the fragment
stripped bare in thunder
the ear around the ear
the INSTANT of the margin
last to be drawn in to the Fraying Hem


Marginia offered the Fraying Hem back its own Time, and the Fraying Hem relented. Time collapsed toward the multiplicity. She offered again back its own Space, and again the Fraying Hem relented. Space folded inward and knelt before Time, and alone each mourned Marginia, Last Reader. Because of them she had come into being.¹⁹


Marginia offered back its own Dimension and Form, and the Fraying Hem relented. Alone each mourned toward the Fraying Hem. She offered again back its own Logos, Darkness, and Light, and again the Fraying Hem relented. One by one were gathered back Logos, Darkness, and Light from the multiplicity, and alone each mourned Marginia, Last Reader. Because of them she had come into being."}],"transform":{"operator":"MIRROR","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)"},"spatial_form":{}}}
